packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:762-818 — the rewritten `loadUsers` catches `Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError`/`HttpError` and rethrows generic ones as `HttpError({statusCode: 500, message: "Unable to load users"})`, discarding the original error's detail/stack before it reaches logs, which weakens diagnosability of DB failures during booking creation (advisory: works today, but any real Prisma error other than `PrismaClientKnownRequestError` — e.g. `PrismaClientInitializationError` on a DB outage — is flattened to an opaque 500 with no forwarded cause) (confidence 60, severity P3).

adjudication_records.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:330-373,424-471 — N+1 query pattern: the loop over destinationCalendar/calendarReference entries now does an independent `prisma.credential.findUnique` per array element when a credential isn't already loaded in memory, instead of batching a single `findMany({ where: { id: { in: [...] } } })`, so collective events with N hosts issue N sequential DB round-trips during event creation/update (confidence 70, P2).

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces per-item DB lookups inside loops. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, for each `destination` it does `this.calendarCredentials.find(...)` and, if missing, performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` inside the `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop. Similarly, in the update path (around `updateBooking` / `updateEvent` handling), it iterates `for (const reference of calendarReference)` and, if the credential isn’t cached, performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } })` per reference. This is a classic N+1/per-element round-trip performance issue; batching with a single `findMany({ where: { id: { in: [...] }}})` would avoid multiple queries. It’s not a correctness defect but a concrete perf/scaling concern introduced by the new array-based destination calendars/references.
